title: Broken Clock
description: A shattered Roman clock erupts into exposed gears and fractured cathedral stone, bound by chain and thorn. The full-panel composition includes a clean transfer stencil, forearm placement mockup, lore and style cards, and a museum-style reference board.
outline_standard: Clean black line art on white, prepared as a tattoo reference outline. Have a licensed tattoo artist review and adapt sizing and transfer setup before use.
